metadata.question: Did over half of the total land area in the Isles Dernières Barrier Islands Refuge become permanently lost to erosion and sea level rise from 2000 to 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Location: Use WDPA polygons to get the official boundary for “Isles Dernières Barrier Islands Refuge”. - Dates: Baseline 1999–2001 (pre-SLC failure for L7, overlaps L5). Recent 2023–2024 (Landsat 8/9). - Collections: Landsat C2 L2 SR (LT05, LE07 for 2000-era; LC08, LC09 for 2024-era). Fallbacks: widen windows; switch to Sentinel-2 if needed. 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - Mask clouds, cloud shadow, cirrus, dilated cloud via QA_PIXEL bits for Landsat; for Sentinel-2 use SCL. - Build median composites per period, compute MNDWI, classify water (MNDWI > 0) vs land. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If image collection size is 0 even after fallbacks: C1. - If valid pixels (post-masking composite) = 0 for either period: C2. - If baseline land area is null or zero (division by zero or invalid): C3. - Otherwise compute loss = (A0 - A1)/A0; if > 0.5 => A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const wdpa = ee.FeatureCollection('WCMC/WDPA/current/polygons'); const aoiCandidates = wdpa.filter(ee.Filter.or( ee.Filter.stringContains('NAME', 'Isles Dern'), ee.Filter.stringContains('ORIG_NAME', 'Isles Dern'), ee.Filter.stringContains('NAME', 'Dernières'), ee.Filter.stringContains('NAME', 'Dernieres') )); const aoiSize = await aoiCandidates.size().getInfo(); if (!aoiSize || aoiSize === 0) { console.log('WDPA matches: 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } const aoi = aoiCandidates.union(1).geometry(); const aoiArea_m2 = await aoi.area(1).getInfo(); console.log(`WDPA matches: ${aoiSize}, AOI km²: ${(aoiArea_m2/1e6).toFixed(2)}`); const baseStart = '1999-01-01', baseEnd = '2001-12-31'; const recentStart = '2023-01-01', recentEnd = '2024-12-31'; // 2. Helpers: Masking & MNDWI function maskScaleL57(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)) // Dilated cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)); // Cirrus const optical = img.select(['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B7']) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2).clamp(0,1); return img.addBands(optical, null, true).updateMask(mask); } function maskScaleL89(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)) // Dilated cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)); // Cirrus const optical = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7']) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2).clamp(0,1); return img.addBands(optical, null, true).updateMask(mask); } function addMNDWI_L57(img) { const green = img.select('SR_B2'); const swir1 = img.select('SR_B5'); const m = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('MNDWI'); return m.updateMask(img.mask().reduce('min')); // preserve valid mask } function addMNDWI_L89(img) { const green = img.select('SR_B3'); const swir1 = img.select('SR_B6'); const m = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('MNDWI'); return m.updateMask(img.mask().reduce('min')); } function s2MaskAndMNDWI(img) { const scl = img.select('SCL'); const valid = scl.eq(4).or(scl.eq(5)).or(scl.eq(6)).or(scl.eq(7)).or(scl.eq(11)); const m = img.select('B3').subtract(img.select('B11')) .divide(img.select('B3').add(img.select('B11'))).rename('MNDWI'); return m.updateMask(valid); } // 3. Data Acquisition & Check const l5_base = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(baseStart, baseEnd).filterBounds(aoi) .map(maskScaleL57).map(addMNDWI_L57); const l7_base = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(baseStart, baseEnd).filterBounds(aoi) .map(maskScaleL57).map(addMNDWI_L57); const baseCol = l5_base.merge(l7_base); let baseCount = await baseCol.size().getInfo(); if (baseCount === 0) { // widen baseline window const l5b = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate('1998-01-01','2002-12-31').filterBounds(aoi) .map(maskScaleL57).map(addMNDWI_L57); const l7b = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate('1998-01-01','2002-12-31').filterBounds(aoi) .map(maskScaleL57).map(addMNDWI_L57); var baseCol2 = l5b.merge(l7b); baseCount = await baseCol2.size().getInfo(); } const l8_recent = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(recentStart, recentEnd).filterBounds(aoi) .map(maskScaleL89).map(addMNDWI_L89); const l9_recent = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(recentStart, recentEnd).filterBounds(aoi) .map(maskScaleL89).map(addMNDWI_L89); let recentCol = l8_recent.merge(l9_recent); let recentCount = await recentCol.size().getInfo(); // Fall back to Sentinel-2 if needed for recent let usedS2Recent = false; if (recentCount === 0) { const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate('2022-01-01','2024-12-31').filterBounds(aoi) .map(function(img){ return img.updateMask(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1<<10).eq(0) .and(img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1<<11).eq(0))); }) // extra mask .map(s2MaskAndMNDWI); recentCol = s2; recentCount = await recentCol.size().getInfo(); usedS2Recent = true; } // If still no data if (baseCount === 0 || recentCount === 0) { console.log(`Baseline Images: ${baseCount}, Recent Images: ${recentCount}`); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`Baseline Images: ${baseCount}`); console.log(`Recent Images: ${recentCount}${usedS2Recent ? ' (S2)' : ''}`); // 4. Composites and Land/Water classification const mndwiBase = baseCount > 0 ? baseCol.median().rename('MNDWI') : null; const mndwiRecent = recentCount > 0 ? recentCol.median().rename('MNDWI') : null; if (mndwiBase === null || mndwiRecent === null) { console.log('C1'); return; } const waterBase = mndwiBase.gt(0); const landBase = waterBase.not().rename('land'); const waterRecent = mndwiRecent.gt(0); const landRecent = waterRecent.not().rename('land'); // 5. Validation: Pixel counts & Areas const scale = 30; const v0Dict = await mndwiBase.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const v1Dict = await mndwiRecent.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const v0 = v0Dict ? (v0Dict.MNDWI || 0) : 0; const v1 = v1Dict ? (v1Dict.MNDWI || 0) : 0; if (v0 === 0 || v1 === 0) { console.log(`Valid pixels 2000-era: ${v0}, 2024-era: ${v1}`); console.log('C2'); return; } const landPix0Dict = await landBase.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const landPix1Dict = await landRecent.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const landPix0 = landPix0Dict ? (landPix0Dict.land || 0) : 0; const landPix1 = landPix1Dict ? (landPix1Dict.land || 0) : 0; const area0_m2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(landBase).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area').getInfo(); const area1_m2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(landRecent).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area').getInfo(); if (area0_m2 === null || area1_m2 === null || area0_m2 <= 0) { console.log(`Areas invalid. A0: ${area0_m2}, A1: ${area1_m2}`); console.log('C3'); return; } const a0_km2 = area0_m2 / 1e6; const a1_km2 = area1_m2 / 1e6; const loss_km2 = a0_km2 - a1_km2; const loss_pct = loss_km2 / a0_km2; // Print concise evidence (<=20 lines total) const totPixApprox = Math.max(1, Math.round(aoiArea_m2 / (scale*scale))); const cov0 = Math.min(100, (v0 / totPixApprox) * 100); const cov1 = Math.min(100, (v1 / totPixApprox) * 100); console.log(`Coverage 2000-era: ${cov0.toFixed(1)}% (valid px: ${v0}), Land px: ${Math.round(landPix0)}`); console.log(`Coverage 2024-era: ${cov1.toFixed(1)}% (valid px: ${v1}), Land px: ${Math.round(landPix1)}`); console.log(`Land 2000-era km²: ${a0_km2.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Land 2024-era km²: ${a1_km2.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Loss km²: ${loss_km2.toFixed(2)}, Loss %: ${(loss_pct*100).toFixed(1)}%`); // 6. Final Answer if (!isFinite(loss_pct)) { console.log('C3'); } else if (loss_pct > 0.5) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
